abcLessons.miniStory: Amy the Apple lived on a tall tree. She was round, red, and loved by all the bees!
Bobby the Ball liked to bounce all day. He rolled down the hill in the most fun way!
Clara the Cat loved to curl and nap. She purred so loudly — just like a clap!
Danny the Duck said quack all day. He splashed in puddles and swam away!
Ella the Elephant had ears so wide. She fanned her friends when they played outside!
Finn the Fish swam in the sea so blue. He made a wish and it came true!
Greta the Giraffe reached the tallest tree. She shared her leaves for everyone to see!
Harry the House had a bright red door. Every friend was welcome — he had room for more!
Ivy the Ice Cream was cold and sweet. She was everyone's favourite summer treat!
Jojo the Jellyfish glowed in the night. She lit up the ocean with colourful light!
Kira the Kite flew way up high. She danced and twirled in the bright blue sky!
Leo the Lion had a mane of gold. He was brave and kind and wonderfully bold!
Mia the Moon glowed soft and bright. She watched over children throughout the night!
Nina the Nest was cosy and warm. She kept baby birds safe in every storm!
Oliver the Owl was wise as could be. He answered questions from behind his tree!
Penny the Penguin waddled with glee. She slid on the ice — one, two, three!
Quinn the Queen was kind and fair. She shared her crown for all to wear!
Ruby the Rainbow appeared after rain. She coloured the sky again and again!
Sunny the Sun rose bright and gold. She warmed the world — brave and bold!
Tara the Tiger had stripes so bright. She loved to play from morning to night!
Uma the Umbrella kept everyone dry. She danced in the rain under a stormy sky!
Vera the Violet grew in the park. She bloomed in the morning and glowed in the dark!
Wally the Whale sang songs so sweet. His music made every ocean wave beat!
Xena the Xylophone rang ding and dong. Everyone danced along to her song!
Yogi the Yak climbed mountains so tall. He yelled "yippee!" and never did fall!
Zara the Zebra had stripes black and white. She zoomed through the grasslands — what a sight!

poems.title: The Busy Bee
poems.poem:
The little bee flies from flower to flower,
Sipping sweet nectar hour by hour.
Buzzing and humming a merry song,
Carrying pollen the whole day long.

poems.title: The Rainy Day
poems.poem:
Pitter-patter, drops of rain,
Dancing down the windowpane.
Puddles form on every street,
Splashing under jumping feet.

poems.title: Counting Stars
poems.poem:
One star, two stars, shining bright,
Three and four light up the night.
Five and six and seven glow,
Eight and nine put on a show.

poems.title: Rainbow Colors
poems.poem:
Red and orange, yellow too,
Then comes green and after blue.
Indigo and violet shine,
Seven colors — all divine!

poems.title: My Garden
poems.poem:
Little seeds beneath the ground,
Waking up without a sound.
Pushing through the muddy earth,
Spring has given them new birth.
